mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 1 month).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 850 thousand units and retail sales below 365,000 million dollars for two consecutive months signal a collapse in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 850 and RSAFS < 365000 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 850 and RSAFS < 365000 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in industrial production below 105 signals a deepening contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105 and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 365,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 365000.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 850 thousand units for two consecutive months signals a collapsing housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 850 for 2 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in unemployment rate above 6.5% and declines in payroll employment below 137,000 thousand persons for two consecutive months signal a severe labor market collapse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.5 and PAYEMS < 137000 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5 and PAYEMS < 137000 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a high federal funds rate compresses corporate cash flows and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
